instruction.text: Selin hält eine Präsentation über Los Angeles. Schaue dir die Präsentation an und höre aufmerksam zu.

atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '90%'>The City of Los Angeles is also called Los Angeles or L.A. <break time='1000ms'/> With almost 3.9 million residents, it is the biggest city in California by population. <break time='1000ms'/> It is also the second largest city in the USA.  </prosody>

instruction.text: Entscheide, ob die Aussagen wahr oder falsch sind.

instruction.text: Selin hält eine Präsentation über Los Angeles. Schaue dir die Präsentation an und höre aufmerksam zu.

atoms.sound: ssml:<prosody rate = '90%'> In the west and the south the city is bordered by the Pacific Ocean. <break time='1000ms'/> In the east and the north it is surrounded by mountain ranges like the Santa Monica Mountains. </prosody>

instruction.text: Selin hält eine Präsentation über Los Angeles. Schaue dir die Präsentation an und höre aufmerksam zu.

atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody rate = '90%'> L.A. is divided into 15 districts. <break time='1000ms'/> They have different functions, for example there are residential districts and business districts. <break time='1000ms'/> Most of the districts are dominated by low-rise buildings. <break time='1000ms'/> Only one of the districts, Downtown Los Angeles, has skyscrapers. </prosody>

atoms.b: Most of the districts in L.A. are dominated by ((++low-rise high-rise)) buildings.
